rationale.intuition: Harvard legacy = 真实 hook (33% of Harvard legacy applicants get in vs 6% non-legacy per SFFA expert data)。Mid-strong profile (3.85/1480) 在 RD 应该比 unhooked profile 显著高，industry 估计 12-22%。

sources.name: Arcidiacono SFFA Expert Witness Report 2018
sources.evidence: Harvard legacy applicants admitted at 33% rate vs 6% non-legacy, controlling for academic strength (Table 5.5R)

sources.name: Harvard CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 3.65%; legacy admit rate not officially published but inferred ~25-35% from Arcidiacono cross-reference

sources.name: Crimson Legacy Benchmark 2024
sources.evidence: Verified Harvard legacy with mid-strong profile clusters 12-25% per published case data
